hints.title: Parity Partition Invariant
hints.text: Swaps can only rearrange characters at even indices among themselves and characters at odd indices among themselves.

hints.title: Even and Odd Sorted Signatures
hints.text: Extract even-indexed characters and odd-indexed characters into two separate sorted strings.

hints.title: Unique Canonical Signature Count
hints.text: Combine the sorted even and sorted odd sub-strings into a signature tuple. Count distinct signatures in a lookup collection.

complexity.notes: Extracting and sorting characters at even and odd indices.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph connected component traversals with pairwise equivalence testing take O(N^2 * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set of signatures requires O(N * L) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Form canonical signatures by sorting even-positioned and odd-positioned characters independently.
